pages.title: Planck Shard
pages.text: A fragment one Planck length across, about 1.6 times ten to the minus thirty-five metres, the scale at which the concept of length stops meaning anything. It cannot be cut smaller because there is no smaller. It looks like a point of light that is somehow also a solid edge.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Sorting through Spacetime Slag in the Maxwell's Demon Sorter, I asked the demon to pick out the smallest pieces. It returned these, and could go no further: the demon itself admitted there was nothing smaller to sort.
